title: Speaking — Managing distractions
description: Part 1 interview, a cue card and a Part 3 discussion on managing distractions.

questions: What part of your work or study do you look forward to?
When do you usually find it easiest to focus?
What would make your workplace or classroom more comfortable?
Do you expect to do something different in future?
What tends to distract you while you work or study?
Have you found a good place to concentrate?

part2.topic: Describe a change that helped you concentrate on one task.
points: what you were trying to do
part2.closing: and explain whether the change helped on other occasions too.

questions: How can shared offices balance collaboration and quiet work?
What role do technology companies have in helping users manage distractions?
What differences would you expect between a large city and a small town in relation to managing distractions?
